A.explanation: Horizontal is $9.73\text{ N}$ because $15.0\sin20.0^{\circ}+6.00\cos40.0^{\circ}$ was used, which sums the vertical-type components instead of the horizontal components.

B.explanation: Both components swap sine and cosine, so horizontal is $15.0\sin20.0^{\circ}+6.00\cos40.0^{\circ} \approx 9.73\text{ N}$ and vertical is $|15.0\cos20.0^{\circ}-6.00\sin40.0^{\circ}| \approx 10.2\text{ N}$.

C.explanation: Horizontal sum $15.0\cos20.0^{\circ}+6.00\sin40.0^{\circ} \approx 18.0\text{ N}$ and vertical difference $|15.0\sin20.0^{\circ}-6.00\cos40.0^{\circ}| \approx 0.534\text{ N}$ are both correct.

hints: Notice the angles are measured from different references: $20.0^{\circ}$ from the horizontal for the $15.0\text{ N}$ force and $40.0^{\circ}$ from the vertical for the $6.00\text{ N}$ force.

Connect each angle to adjacent and opposite sides: for the $15.0\text{ N}$ force horizontal uses cosine and vertical uses sine, but for the $6.00\text{ N}$ force measured from vertical this is reversed.

Next add the two rightward horizontal parts for the resultant horizontal magnitude, and subtract the upward $15.0\sin20.0^{\circ}$ part and downward $6.00\cos40.0^{\circ}$ part for the resultant vertical magnitude.
walkthrough: Identify the directions: $15.0\text{ N}$ is $20.0^{\circ}$ above the horizontal to the right, so it has rightward and upward parts. $6.00\text{ N}$ is $40.0^{\circ}$ from the vertical toward the right, so it has rightward and downward parts.
State the resolution rule: component adjacent to the angle uses cosine and component opposite the angle uses sine.

Set up the horizontal components: $F_{x1}=15.0\cos20.0^{\circ}$ and $F_{x2}=6.00\sin40.0^{\circ}$ because $40.0^{\circ}$ is opposite the horizontal direction. Both act to the right, so $F_x = F_{x1}+F_{x2}$.
Substitute with units: $F_x = 15.0\cos20.0^{\circ}+6.00\sin40.0^{\circ} \approx 14.1\text{ N}+3.86\text{ N} \approx 18.0\text{ N}$.
Set up the vertical components: $F_{y1}=15.0\sin20.0^{\circ}$ upward and $F_{y2}=6.00\cos40.0^{\circ}$ downward. The resultant magnitude is the difference because they oppose.
Substitute with units: $F_y = |5.13\text{ N}-4.60\text{ N}| \approx 0.534\text{ N}$, with a small net upward effect.
Match $18.0\text{ N}$ horizontal and $0.534\text{ N}$ vertical to the table. This is option C.
